newsitem.title: USA: News Corp's Fox Kids files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: News Corp's Fox Kids files for IPO.

text.p: Fox Kids Worldwide Inc, part of News Corp, said it filed for an initial public offering of common stock.
Fox Kids, which produces the "Mighty Morphin Power Rangers", did not release terms of the planned offering, but said all shares are being sold by the company.
Merrill Lynch is the lead underwriter of the offering.
At the close of the offering, Fox Kids Worldwide Inc will become the parent company for Fox Children's Network Inc and Saban Entertainment.
Fox Children's Network produces such shows as "Goosebumps", "Casper the Friendly Ghost", "Spiderman" and "The Adventures of Batman and Robin".
